verdict.rationale: Recurly documents usage-based billing, with consumption-driven add-ons, measured units tracked across plans, and charges at the end of each billing cycle. This implies some way of recording usage. However, the evidence never describes a usage-event ingestion API, let alone the high-volume streaming pipeline this story needs. Missing for 10: a documented high-volume usage-event ingestion/streaming API, idempotency keys or deduplication on ingestion, backdating of usage timestamps, examples covering API calls, tokens or compute-seconds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
